rungs.name: r1_gauss
rungs.what: BuildingSim bank v1 (20 fault types, generic controls) + Gaussian sensor noise + source channel patterns

rungs.name: r2_realnoise
rungs.what: + real-noise/quirk model from dev fault-free days (residual library, offsets, fan-off drift)

rungs.name: r3_calib
rungs.what: + dev-calibrated bank v3: BMS logs commands not positions (twin test), operator start/stop jitter and off-blocks, schedule-shift faults, 24x7 units, wider VAV-min/SAT priors

rungs.name: r4_damper
rungs.what: + dev calibration v4: installed OA-damper characteristic (logged command vs actual outdoor-air fraction) and larger static sensor disagreement (MA stratification, zone vs return)

rungs.name: r5_bothbanks
rungs.what: train on bank v1 (generic controls) + bank v3 (calibrated) together, noise v4, 50k days

rungs.name: r6_wide
rungs.what: wider network (64/128 channels, 179k weights) and 10 epochs, bank v3 + noise v4
